title: [Peek] Fix title bar button being focused on start up, and fix scrolling and interaction in interactive previewers
author: daverayment

actions.label: Post general review notes as COMMENT

review.body:
### Scope initial focus clearing to startup and guard the XamlRoot lifecycle

**Severity:** `high`

Please clear the initial title-bar focus only once after the window has been shown, and only when one of the title-bar buttons is actually focused. The preview-size event can run during later resizing or navigation, so redirecting focus on every event can steal focus from an interactive preview. Also return before querying `FocusManager` when `XamlRoot` is null; the first preview-size notification can occur before the window is fully connected.

### Keep the focus sink out of normal tab navigation

**Severity:** `medium`

The hidden `FocusSink` should remain non-tab-stop during normal navigation. Temporarily enabling it only around the programmatic focus transfer prevents the sink from becoming an unexpected keyboard-navigation target while still allowing the startup focus redirect to work.

### Preserve interactive-preview navigation and add regression coverage

**Severity:** `medium`

The low-level hook should intercept Left/Right only when Alt is pressed; otherwise normal arrow keys must continue to reach interactive preview controls such as WebView2. Please add or retain focused UI coverage for both title-bar buttons not receiving initial focus and Alt+Left/Alt+Right changing the selected file while an interactive preview has focus.
